scope: Full test diffs, original fixture contracts, affected production consumers and existing root-owned first-failure evidence. No build, test or native program was executed by this reviewer; this is not formal acceptance.

findings.finding: The original and recursive Source fixtures are unchanged. The recursive fixture indexes arrays of qualified Leaf values and retains tuple/record/variant field checks and the full 18446744073709551557u64 result. Only its index observation changes to require both AddressIndex and ReadAddress; the ordinary original fixture still requires ExtractIndex. All five other common opcode checks, Types success, subsequent complete compilation with verification_runs == 1, and separate Clang O0/O2 native success/full-u64 stdout requirements remain. The retained fifth Typed shows the actual array projection AddressIndex -> AddressField -> ReadAddress at lines 7564/7585/7606 and 7880/7901/7922, rather than ExtractIndex. Production addresses.rs constructs the indexed address with its element type, and aggregates.rs reads the addressed value through the existing qualified-place branch. The assertion change matches the actual consumer and does not waive its later Analyze/Verify/native obligations.

All four alias/array/assignment/tuple good/bad source pairs are byte-for-byte retained. Equal-life array and tuple cases lose the obsolete Core-only success plus later Types Unsupported expectation and now require Verify success, exactly one verifier execution and terminal_native_profiles(...,42), alongside the existing alias/assignment cases. That helper builds/runs Clang O0/O2 and, with llvm-api enabled, LlvmApi O0/O2, checking the actual backend and exact result. Every distinct-life SafeReject plus distinct declared lifetime classes diagnostic stays. Unused-method negatives, the existing generic-host capability Unsupported fence, ordinary-host positive and reborrow native42 remain unchanged. This raises executable obligations; no negative source was promoted or erased.

Both schema attack payloads and both raw/Wire input paths are unchanged: attack 0 changes arguments[2] to I32(43), attack 1 changes life_context.nodes[0] to Bool. validate_record_relocations must still return an error. The broad obsolete message fragment becomes exact Phase::Ct, E-UNSUPPORTED and respectively complete ordered nominal actual vector / complete nominal context graph messages. The production relocation_arguments compares the complete ordered argument vector after charging traversal; relocation_context_pair compares nodes/root/context shape after graph-cost reservation. Neighboring private-proof, raw instruction, life-ordinal and source-call attacks remain. This commit changes no producer, consumer or raw-input acceptance code.

The seven-line production change handles only GenericArg::Type containing existing TypeKind::MetaEval when the actual declaration parameter is Const. It preserves the existing expression via carrier, which charges const_expression before cloning. instantiate_inner first reconstructs original observed arguments, enforces formal arity and normalizes every Const or expression actual; its instance_types representation deliberately stores normalized arguments as GenericArg::Type. All eight consts::argument call sites were traced: ordinary calls/record/type reconstruction feed instantiate normalization, aliases/enums/stored nominal actuals normalize the declared domain, and static method/function checks either normalize closed literals or authenticate symbolic consts against the original source declaration, domain and exact local ordinal. Type-formal normalization still rejects expression carriers; scalar domain/suffix/range and closed-value checks are unchanged. This repairs a representation round trip without trusting MetaEval itself as authority. The original CT3 scalar nominal fixture and its wrong-domain/wrong-scalar rejection assertions are unchanged. No default quota or public Wire/source permission is changed.
